SEED_POLICIES.name: Dormant privileged accounts
SEED_POLICIES.desc: Disable privileged accounts after 45 days of inactivity.

SEED_POLICIES.name: Excessive permission remediation
SEED_POLICIES.desc: Remove standing admin rights that exceed least privilege.

SEED_POLICIES.name: Contractor account lifecycle
SEED_POLICIES.desc: Move expired contractor accounts to the quarantine OU.

SEED_POLICIES.name: Stale share access review
SEED_POLICIES.desc: Flag and revoke share access unused for more than 90 days.

SEED_POLICIES.name: Service account review
SEED_POLICIES.desc: Report inactive service accounts without changing them.

SEED_POLICIES.name: Regional user cleanup
SEED_POLICIES.desc: Cleanup policy for regional office organizational units.

SEED_POLICIES.name: Leaver account quarantine
SEED_POLICIES.desc: Move inactive leaver accounts to the quarantine OU.

SEED_POLICIES.name: Legacy computer accounts
SEED_POLICIES.desc: Disable computer accounts inactive for more than 120 days.

HYGIENE_TASKS.label: Inactive accounts
HYGIENE_TASKS.desc: User and computer accounts that haven’t signed in for a set number of days.

HYGIENE_TASKS.label: Empty groups
HYGIENE_TASKS.desc: Security and distribution groups with no direct members.

HYGIENE_TASKS.label: Password never expires
HYGIENE_TASKS.desc: Accounts whose password is set never to expire, often forgotten service and admin accounts.
HYGIENE_TASKS.intro: Accounts are checked on every run. Passwords are never reset and password policies are not changed.

actions.name: Report matching accounts
actions.desc: Emails the list of accounts with a non-expiring password. Nothing in Active Directory changes.

actions.name: Remove “Password never expires”
actions.desc: Clears the flag so the account follows the domain password policy again. No other property is touched.

HYGIENE_TASKS.label: Dormant privileged accounts
HYGIENE_TASKS.desc: Inactive accounts that still belong to admin groups, including nested membership.
HYGIENE_TASKS.intro: Covers Domain, Enterprise and Schema Admins, Administrators and the Operators groups. Each enabled step runs once an account has been inactive for the set number of days.

actions.name: Report dormant privileged accounts
actions.desc: Emails the list with the privileged groups each account belongs to. Nothing changes.

actions.name: Disable the account
actions.desc: Prevents sign-in while keeping the account and its group membership intact.

actions.name: Move to a quarantine OU
actions.desc: Relocates the account to a quarantine OU for review.

HYGIENE_TASKS.label: Disabled accounts
HYGIENE_TASKS.desc: Accounts that have stayed disabled beyond a retention period.
HYGIENE_TASKS.intro: Retention is counted from the date the account was disabled, or from its last change when that date is unavailable.

actions.name: Report disabled accounts
actions.desc: Emails the list of accounts past the retention period. Nothing changes.

actions.name: Move to an archive OU
actions.desc: Relocates the account to an archive OU so it can still be restored.

actions.name: Delete the account
actions.desc: Permanently removes the account from Active Directory.

HYGIENE_TASKS.label: Orphaned computers
HYGIENE_TASKS.desc: Computer accounts that have stopped authenticating. Domain controllers are always skipped.
HYGIENE_TASKS.intro: Recommended order: disable first, quarantine next and delete only after a longer period. Domain controllers are never changed.

actions.name: Report stale computers
actions.desc: Emails the list with OS, last logon and password-last-set dates. Nothing changes.

actions.name: Disable the computer
actions.desc: Stops the device authenticating while keeping the object.

actions.name: Move to a quarantine OU
actions.desc: Relocates the computer to a quarantine OU for review.

actions.name: Delete the computer
actions.desc: Permanently removes the computer account from Active Directory.

HYGIENE_TASKS.label: Stale devices
HYGIENE_TASKS.desc: Registered devices with no recent activity.
HYGIENE_TASKS.intro: Activity uses the device’s approximate last sign-in. Devices with no activity data are shown as unknown and never changed.

actions.name: Report stale devices
actions.desc: Emails the list with OS, trust type and last activity. Nothing changes in Entra ID.

actions.name: Disable the device
actions.desc: Blocks the device from authenticating while keeping its registration.

actions.name: Delete the device
actions.desc: Permanently removes the device from Entra ID.

HYGIENE_TASKS.label: Inactive users
HYGIENE_TASKS.desc: Member users who haven’t signed in for a set period. Guests are handled separately.
HYGIENE_TASKS.intro: Global Administrators and emergency-access accounts are always skipped. Synced users are reported only, so they can be fixed in Active Directory.

actions.name: Report inactive users
actions.desc: Emails the list with last sign-in and whether each user is cloud-only or synced. Nothing changes.

actions.name: Block sign-in
actions.desc: Stops the user signing in while keeping the account and licences.

actions.name: Delete cloud-only user
actions.desc: Removes the user from Entra ID. Synced users are never deleted here.

HYGIENE_TASKS.label: Guest accounts
HYGIENE_TASKS.desc: External guests that are inactive or never redeemed their invitation.
HYGIENE_TASKS.intro: Guests who never redeemed their invitation are counted from the day they were invited.

actions.name: Report inactive guests
actions.desc: Emails the list with sponsor, invitation state and last sign-in. Nothing changes.

actions.name: Block sign-in
actions.desc: Stops the guest signing in while keeping the account.

actions.name: Delete the guest
actions.desc: Permanently removes the guest account from Entra ID.

HYGIENE_TASKS.label: MFA registration
HYGIENE_TASKS.desc: Users who aren’t registered for multi-factor authentication.
HYGIENE_TASKS.intro: Audit only. This task never changes users, authentication methods or Conditional Access.

actions.name: Report users without MFA
actions.desc: Emails the list with registration status, registered methods and admin roles.

actions.name: Attach a CSV export
actions.desc: Adds the full result as a CSV file that can be shared for follow-up.

HYGIENE_TASKS.label: Inactive applications
HYGIENE_TASKS.desc: App registrations and service principals that look unused.
HYGIENE_TASKS.intro: Apps without reliable activity data are marked “Needs review” and never changed. Applications are not deleted by this task.

actions.name: Report inactive applications
actions.desc: Emails each app with its signals: sign-ins, owners, credential expiry and assignments.

actions.name: Disable sign-in
actions.desc: Stops the service principal signing in. The app and its permissions are kept.

DEFAULT_RUNGS.name: Set a random password
DEFAULT_RUNGS.desc: Locks the account by resetting its password to a random value.

DEFAULT_RUNGS.name: Disable the account
DEFAULT_RUNGS.desc: Prevents sign-in while keeping the account and its data intact.

DEFAULT_RUNGS.name: Move to an Inactive OU
DEFAULT_RUNGS.desc: Relocates the account to a quarantine OU for easy review.

DEFAULT_RUNGS.name: Delete the account
DEFAULT_RUNGS.desc: Permanently removes the account from Active Directory.

DEFAULT_GROUP_RUNGS.name: Report empty groups
DEFAULT_GROUP_RUNGS.desc: Emails the list of empty groups to the recipients. Nothing in Active Directory changes.

DEFAULT_GROUP_RUNGS.name: Move to a quarantine OU
DEFAULT_GROUP_RUNGS.desc: Relocates the group to a quarantine OU for easy review.

DEFAULT_GROUP_RUNGS.name: Delete the group
DEFAULT_GROUP_RUNGS.desc: Permanently removes the group from Active Directory.
